summary: Checked all six estimates against the complete 75,323-character markdown conversion and the cited PDF pages, including the Table 1 text; the paper ends with references and has no appendix. Found two count-scope problems in the light-ring homogenization record. All nine non-null outcome statistics match their printed values and arms. The other estimate counts and the requested outcome coding fields are supported. Both supplied script flags are false positives: PDF p. 7, Section 4.2.3 prints the flexibility mean as "4,2", correctly represented by JSON number 4.2; PDF p. 8, Figure 5 explicitly describes "two bubble charts", one for each condition-wide pool, supporting unit=set and n_units=2. No eligible full-sample outcome or contrast is missing. The separate creativity tests compare subsets of the randomized groups and are not full-sample contrasts; their uncertainty must not be attached to the combined-arm estimate. Baseline measures, self-reports, within-arm correlations, and process classifications are appropriately excluded. No uncertainty is printed for the six full-sample records, so se_basis=not_reported is appropriate. Figure-only category counts remain null under extraction rule 1.
